title: Political instability: pronunciamientos and caudillos
goal: I can say what presidents, officers and caudillos used to do in the decades after independence.

items: I can say what presidents and officers used to do in Mexico after independence.
I can explain what a pronunciamiento was.
I can say who Santa Anna was in one sentence.
I can explain what a caudillo was and give one example.
I can use solían and solía + infinitive to say what usually happened.
